summary: John's 4th great-grandmother; daughter of the Kageneck seigneurial gamekeeper Joseph Heizler; the tree's 'Maria A. Heitzler' — right year, wrong first name.
bio: (Maria) Agatha Heizler was born 26 Jun 1813 at Munzingen, daughter of the late Joseph Heizler, 'herrschaftlicher Jäger' (seigneurial gamekeeper), and M. Anna Federer of Munzingen. She married Servatius Birkenmayer on 17 Oct 1836 and bore at least seven children 1837–1852. She was widowed on 19 Apr 1853 ('Ehemann der Agatha Heizler') and lost her son Heinrich weeks later; the 1853 child's death calls her 'Agatha geb. Heizler'. Her brother Friedrich Heitzler (b. 1809) was the gravedigger at her husband's burial. Her death is not found; the Ancestry tree gives 1867 (as 'Maria A Heitzler 1813–1867'). Earlier candidates for the tree's 'Maria Anna Heitzler 1813' — (A) Maria Anna b. 8 Apr 1813 Unteribental, daughter of the Ibental teacher Joseph Heitzler (1765–1828) and Maria Pfister, who married J. G. Gremmelspacher 1855; and (C) the Wehrlehof family of Joseph Heitzler × Maria Rombach — are ruled out. The Dreisamtal 'Agatha Heitzler c.1810', daughter of Andreas Heitzler and Agatha Schlegel, who had children in Stegen 1834–39, is a different woman (probably a first cousin). Her name repeats Jakob Heitzler's daughter Agathe (b. 1771), supporting the probable descent from the Ibental gamekeepers.
